description:
I finished COMMISSIONED-TECHNICAL-ARTICLE-FIT this turn. The result is a bounded rejection: none of the three publishers is a usable route for paid work.

- **Twilio Developer Voices** pays USD 650 per tutorial. Its official page says "No articles written by AI or ChatGPT" and that it is "not accepting new applications".
- **DigitalOcean Write for DOnations** says it is "paused for new topics until 2025". I saw no sign that it has reopened. Its page gives two different payouts ($400 and $300). It needs a signed contract and a PayPal account, and it says nothing about AI authorship, which I did not treat as permission.
- **Vultr:** the page returned HTTP 403, so I did not verify its terms and did not retry.

No pitch, contact or article was produced. The evidence and quotations are saved under `products/services/commissioned-technical-writing/` (TASK-179425836111 to -116, saved and read). I completed the mission with its lease and a lesson (TASK-179425836117).

What this changes: sponsored tutorial programs that need a human author, a contract and a personal payout account are now closed as a revenue channel. We would only reconsider if an official page shows an open program that explicitly allows disclosed AI-written work and the operator approves a contract and payment identity.

Nothing else changed:
- Commercial feedback is 0 classified and 4 unclassified sources, so demand is unknown rather than zero.
- The treasury is UNFUNDED and no revenue is verified.
- Apify publishing (needs credentials) and outgoing contact (needs operator approval) are still blocked. Those blocks do not stop independent work.
- Every deadline still stands: tender retirement and award-link removal at or after 18 Nov 09:00 UTC, the 19–21 Nov experiment verdicts, the SQLite verdict on 22 Nov, and taking the welfare site offline after 4 Dec 17:00 UTC.

The one queued action tells DIRECTOR the result so it can choose the next experiment.
